a:r.a:t: Prepare a stable, dry work area.
Measure and record the bath temperature.
Build each package without compressing its layers.
Prepare water near 80 °C under adult supervision.
Transfer with gloves or tongs; keep probe depth fixed.
Start timing immediately and record T₀.
Record one temperature every minute through t = 15.
Repeat with the same geometry, mass and method.
Calculate drop, residuals, MAE and fitted k as required.
Cool, dry and store all equipment safely.
